# Private concerns about course materials

This repository distributes course PDFs. If you notice an accidentally published
private file, personal information, or another concern requiring confidential
handling, email [spadon@dal.ca](mailto:spadon@dal.ca). Do not repeat sensitive
information in a public issue or pull request.

Privacy and sharing requirements follow the
[CSCI 3141 syllabus](../assets/planning/syllabus.pdf).
